facts.business: Fratelli Vineyards Limited is an Indian winemaking company formed through an Indo-Italian alliance between the Sekhri and Secci families, producing premium wines across 13 collections and 50+ labels from vineyards in Maharashtra and distributing through 31,000+ touchpoints.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on significant decline in revenue from operations and going concern basis for standalone financial statements

key_risks: Significant decline in standalone revenue due to business restructuring from agri-commodity trading to wine business
Continued losses on standalone and consolidated basis
Dependence on subsidiary Fratelli Wines Private Limited for consolidated revenue
Going concern consideration for standalone entity
facts.related_party_note: Loan of Rs 932.50 lakh given to wholly owned subsidiary Fratelli Wines Private Limited repayable on demand @10%; Other receivables from related parties Rs 30.07 lakh
